mapper.insert: INSERT INTO action_execution (remediation_action_id, approval_request_id, idempotency_key, status, executor_key, recovery_policy_id, recovery_policy_version, recovery_policy_snapshot, execution_context_schema_name, execution_context_schema_version, execution_context_payload, reconciliation_attempt_count, max_reconciliation_attempts, correlation_id, created_at, updated_at, lock_version) VALUES (#{execution.remediationActionId}, #{execution.approvalRequestId}, #{execution.idempotencyKey}, 'PENDING', #{execution.executorKey}, #{execution.recoveryPolicyId}, #{execution.recoveryPolicyVersion}, #{execution.recoveryPolicySnapshot}, #{execution.executionContextSchemaName}, #{execution.executionContextSchemaVersion}, #{execution.executionContextPayload}, 0, #{execution.maxReconciliationAttempts}, #{execution.correlationId}, #{execution.at}, #{execution.at}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, status FROM action_execution WHERE remediation_action_id = #{actionId}
SELECT id FROM action_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id

SELECT e.id, e.status, e.lock_version, e.remediation_action_id, p.id AS plan_id, p.incident_id, CAST(e.execution_context_payload AS CHAR) AS context, e.started_at, e.reconciliation_attempt_count, e.max_reconciliation_attempts, e.last_reconciliation_at, e.reconciliation_deadline_at FROM action_execution e JOIN remediation_action a ON a.id = e.remediation_action_id JOIN remediation_plan p ON p.id = a.remediation_plan_id WHERE e.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE action_execution SET status = 'RUNNING', execution_context_payload = #{context}, started_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE action_execution SET reconciliation_attempt_count = reconciliation_attempt_count + 1, last_reconciliation_at = #{at}, reconciliation_deadline_at = COALESCE(reconciliation_deadline_at, #{deadline}), updated_at = #{at}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion} AND reconciliation_attempt_count < max_reconciliation_attempts

UPDATE action_execution SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_schema_name = #{schemaName}, result_schema_version = #{schemaVersion}, result_payload = #{payload}, finished_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE action_execution SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from} AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE remediation_plan SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{planId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
